title: The libsufr design documents describe dev at f085e43
body:
Branch `design-goals` holds `design/DESIGN_GOALS.md`, `PROBLEMS.md`, `SOLUTIONS.md` and `UNSOLVED.md`, last brought up to date for dev at 657e16d in 8ab993d. The refactor squash f085e43 fixes many of the problems they list and adds some. A review against the goals on 2026-11-13, mostly by code reading, found:

## Fixed by f085e43

- `SufrFile` and its public fields, with `FileAccess` showing through them
- `SufrMetadata`, with its file name, time and `chrono` types
- `list` and its printing inside the library
- the `low_memory` flags on build, read and every query
- reads that took `&mut self`, and the per-query option and result structs
- queries as `Vec<String>`, and `string_at`

## Still open

- `SuffixArray::open_with` writes the subsample cache to `~/.sufr` (sufr-22b9c3)
- `SeedMask` has public fields, so a caller can build an inconsistent mask
- `SuffixSortType` is an exhaustive enum
- `anyhow::Result` is the error type of every fallible function
- libsufr parses FASTA itself, with `needletail`
- `OUTFILE_VERSION` is exported without a feature flag

## New in f085e43

- `OpenOptions`, `Context`, `Location` and `Extraction` have only public fields, and `SourceKind` and `Alphabet` are exhaustive enums, so adding a field or variant breaks callers. `Alphabet::Dna { ignore_softmask }` is a struct variant.
- The `typed` feature exports `TypedSuffixArray`, whose only public method is `open`. Its search and read methods are `pub(crate)`, and nothing turns it into a `SuffixArray`.
- `SuffixArray::text`, `suffixes` and `lcps` return new `Vec`s, `text` copying even from memory, and `Hits::locate` and `Hits::extract` collect.
- `SuffixArrayBuilder::from_data` checks nothing about its text. No sequences, a first start other than 0, or no trailing `$` give a file that later panics or stores wrong LCPs (sufr-b96ee1).

## Proposal

Bring the four documents on `design-goals` up to date for f085e43, as 8ab993d did for 657e16d.
